page.layout: One table in one column. Year numbers stand to the left of the column, one group of four lines per year (1432 to 1439), with rules between the groups.; One column of table rows, ruled between groups, under the running head at top right. Words are cut off at the left edge of the column.; One column of short marginal notes in the right margin, in three groups, beside the upper and middle part of the page. A black rule runs down the left, and a fragment of text sits at the lower left. Page number at top right.

note.i: Pacta conventa Croningensium cum Haijone & Bolone Ripp. aliaque specialia cum quibusdam in agro.
Pacta conventa cum eodem Haijone & Bolone repetita.
Transactio civitatis Gronig. cum Hamburg. & pax reddita Houwerdaes[?] & Epponi Gockin-ga.
Transactio specialis cum Ailcone Houwerda, de arce Muntensi.

page.notes: The year numbers are old-style figures; the 2 in 1432 is raised. Several names end in partly unclear letters, marked [?]. Names are shown as far as they are legible on this part of the page. Left edges of the lines are cut off, so the first letters of many rows are missing; these fragments are transcribed as they stand. Readings marked [?] are uncertain: the long s in Maurissinge is read from its ff-like form, and Baroldes is doubtful. "V 3 Lubb" at the foot is printed text and is kept as a line. Right margin: the notes are set in italic type; "Gronig." and "Houwerdaes" are uncertain readings. The page number 285 is printed in a decorative style and is not certain. The fragment "ert" at the lower left is only partly visible and may be the end of a word from the main text.
